verdict.rationale: Postman documents an MCP Gateway feature for registering third-party MCP servers and making them available to a team (postman-docs-7), plus an 'MCP Generator' for building MCP servers from Postman's API collections (postman-docs-9), and Agent Mode that acts on natural-language instructions across the API lifecycle (postman-docs-8/29). However, the evidence centers on registering/hosting/generating MCP servers rather than a clear first-party client flow where a user drops in an arbitrary external MCP server and Postman's own AI agent immediately consumes its tools end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Agent Mode directly invoking tools from a user-added external MCP server, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
